item.title: Welcome to Fireworks of Structure
item.dc:creator: Bruno Wang
item.description:
Welcome.

This site is primarily about mathematical writing, with occasional notes on language and code. An ideal essay does more than state a result: it preserves the path into the problem, the decisive turn, and the intuition behind the notation.

The first worked essay studies a cosine sum in the regular heptadecagon. Long-form pieces will appear under Posts, shorter public notes under Thoughts, and connected work under Series.
